question: P is the brother of R. R is the father of Q. S is the wife of Q. T is the daughter of S. How is P related to T?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

Let's draw the family tree based on the given information:

 
• P is the brother of R. 
 
• R is the father of Q. 
 
• S is the wife of Q. 
 
• T is the daughter of S. 

From the above relations, we can deduce:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0464c5d42a90c21711e35c1254e9b6f5f0ee47c4a1b729e088919a0df03656bb.png] 

Therefore, P is the **Father's father's brother **of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
